verse.verse_1: In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful.
verse.verse_2: All praise unto Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.
verse.verse_4: Sovereign of the Day of Requital.
verse.verse_5: Thee alone do we worship and of Thee alone do we seek help,
verse.verse_6: Guide us Thou unto the path straight
verse.verse_7: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured. Not of those on whom is indignation brought down, nor of the astray.
